liturgicalName: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph
keyVerseDR: "Who arose, and took the child and his mother by night, and retired into Egypt..." (Mt 2:14)

level1.title: Joseph Keeps Jesus Safe
level1.story: An angel told Joseph, "Take Jesus and Mary to Egypt!" Joseph kept them safe. Later they came home to Nazareth.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you help your family?
level1.prayer: Holy Family, bless my family. Amen.

activity.title: Love my family
activity.intro: Joseph kept his family safe. Show your family love!

level2.title: The Holy Family Flees
level2.story: After the wise men left, an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Rise, take the child and His mother, and flee to Egypt," the angel said, because King Herod wanted to harm Jesus. Joseph got up in the night and took them to Egypt. When Herod died, the angel told Joseph it was safe to go home. The Holy Family settled in Nazareth, where Jesus grew up.
level2.keyLine: Who arose, and took the child and his mother by night.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did Joseph protect his family?
actions: Do a chore without being asked
level2.prayer: Jesus, Mary and Joseph, make our home holy. Amen.

activity.title: Our family promises
activity.intro: The Holy Family loved and protected each other. Write 2 promises.
starters: Our family will help each other...
